pages.title: Root
pages.text:
**Sprout.** A wheat field, a kitchen, then Mystical Agriculture. Sieve dirt for Inferium Ore and gravel for Prosperity Ore — smelt them, and the essence-seed tiers open up. Botany pots if you like compact.\
Food is infrastructure here. A Clowder that eats well leaves the pad sooner.

pages.title: Before you move on
pages.text: Finish Sprout. Claim the token and seat it. The Sprout notch lights. Keep a food source running before you leave the pad.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Read **Start here** for worked examples. Recipes live in JEI; the **Spirit Codex** covers Tribal Power machinery. If you get stuck, test one recipe at a time and sneak-use the Spirit Codex on a silent machine.
